vendor.zh: 字节跳动 · 火山引擎

access.zh: 火山方舟 API 与豆包 App；权重不开源。
access.en: Volcengine Ark API and the Doubao app; weights are not open.

generations.zh: 当前代：模型广场列 doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260628（256k 上下文 / 256k 输出）与 2.1-turbo；另有 doubao-seed-evolving（1024k / 256k，Coding & Agent 持续升级定位）。
generations.en: Current line: the model marketplace lists doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260628 (256k context / 256k output) and 2.1-turbo; plus doubao-seed-evolving (1024k / 256k, pitched as a continuously upgraded Coding & Agent model).

generations.zh: 上一代：2.0-pro/lite/mini（256k 上下文 / 128k 输出；lite 为官方口径「首款全模态理解模型」）；260215 档标注「即将下线」——闭源代次更替的直接证据。
generations.en: Previous line: 2.0-pro/lite/mini (256k context / 128k output; lite billed by the vendor as its "first omni-modal understanding model"); the 260215 snapshots are marked "soon to be retired" — direct evidence of closed-line churn.

v.zh: 2.0-lite 起官方标注多模态理解（音视图文）；GUI 任务处理与工具调用在列（同上）
v.en: From 2.0-lite the marketplace marks multimodal understanding (audio/video/image/text); GUI task handling and tool calling listed (same page)

v.zh: 模型广场现役 2.1-pro / 2.1-turbo 已是 260628 快照；10-20 快照里标「即将下线」的 260215 档已不在广场在册——闭源谱系按月更代的现场样本，本站按快照记录
v.en: The marketplace now runs 2.1-pro / 2.1-turbo at the 260628 snapshot; the 260215 snapshot marked "soon to be retired" in the 10-20 snapshot is no longer listed — a live sample of monthly closed-line churn; recorded as a snapshot

positioning.zh: 国产闭源主力：对话产品「豆包」与 API「Doubao-Seed」同族两条线；服务在网信办备案（Beijing-YunQue-20230821，豆包大模型=云雀更名，官方备案公示页确认）。代次更替快，本站卡带核验日与复核周期。
positioning.en: The domestic closed flagship: the Doubao consumer app and the Doubao-Seed API are two lines of one family; the service is CAC-filed (Beijing-YunQue-20230821 — Doubao LLM is the renamed YunQue, confirmed on the official filing-disclosure page). Generations churn fast, so the card carries a check date and review interval.

onSite.zh: 权重不开源，本站无量化对比；对话产品三要素轻档案在 AI 工具站（对话问答区）。
onSite.en: No open weights, no quantisation coverage; the three-essentials light entry for the app lives on the tools site (chat section).
